name: Tame Your Tongue
overview: Scripture calls believers to exercise careful control over their speech, recognizing the tongue's power to either harm or heal. Psalms urges us to keep our tongues from evil and to seek God's help in guarding our lips, while Proverbs highlights the wisdom in restraint and the impact of words, contrasting harmful speech with the healing influence of a wholesome tongue. A gentle answer is shown to defuse anger, emphasizing that taming our tongues is essential for spiritual health and godly wisdom.
